Title: Once Upon a Time in China II
FullTitle: 黃飛鴻之二：男兒當自強
SortTitle: Once Upon a Time in China II
Plot: Wong Fei-Hung faces the White Lotus Society, a fanatical cult seeking to drive the Europeans out of China through violence, even attacking Chinese who follow Western ways. Wong must also defend revolutionary Dr. Sun Yat Sen from the military.
